title: Content-Security-Policy delivered in report-only mode
description: The response sets Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, so the policy collects violation reports while the browser enforces nothing. Teams often keep this mode for longer than intended, and header inventories then list a CSP as present even though no restriction applies. The check flags the report-only header.
remediation: Promote the policy to the enforcing Content-Security-Policy header once reports are clean, keeping the report-only copy during the transition (an enforcing Content-Security-Policy).
limitation: Header observation only: the policy contents and the violation reports are not evaluated.
